notes:
CARE LEAVE VOCABULARY:
{介護休暇|かいごきゅうか} is leave taken to care for family members who need nursing care.

TWO TYPES OF CARE LEAVE:
- {介護休暇|かいごきゅうか} - short-term care leave (typically up to 5 days per year)
- ⟦{介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう}→介護休業：23751_kaigokyuugyou⟧ - long-term care leave (up to 93 days total)

CULTURAL NOTE:
As Japan's population ages, {介護休暇|かいごきゅうか} has become increasingly important. The law allows employees to take leave to care for:
- Parents
- Spouse
- Children
- Other family members needing care
{介護離職|かいごりしょく} (leaving work due to care responsibilities) is a growing social issue, which is why the government promotes {介護休暇|かいごきゅうか} and ⟦{介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう}→介護休業：23751_kaigokyuugyou⟧.
